name: User Manual
description: Provides a place to build an in-site user manual/documentation.
project_description:
What's it for? 
 The User Manual module provides a simple way to store site documentation or other content aimed at content authors and contributors rather than site users.

 Features 
 
 Easy access to manual content via the admin toolbar. 
 Lightweight: defines a single entity type which supports multiple bundles . 
 Manual content is separate from site content. It will not appear in admin/content or Views which display nodes. 
 User manual entities are fieldable , so standard Drupal features and common add-ons such as Paragraphs can easily be incorporated.
